This indicates an issue with collecting or iterating over attribute nodes, likely related to how attributes are handled in the DOM model implementation.

The classes `DOMAttributeIterator`, `DOMAttributePointer`, and `DOMNodePointer` in `org.apache.commons.jxpath.ri.model.dom` package are relevant here since they deal with DOM attributes and nodes and their iteration and pointer mechanisms. The `DOMAttributeIterator` class has methods including the constructor, `testAttr(org.w3c.dom.Attr)`, `equalStrings`, `getAttribute`, `getNodePointer`, `getPosition`, and `setPosition`. It is likely responsible for iterating over attributes for a given attribute axis expression. Any bug in iterating all attributes or in filtering attributes based on namespace or name will cause such failures.

The `DOMAttributePointer` class manages individual attribute pointers, dealing with name, namespace URI, and value retrieval. The `DOMNodePointer` class manages general DOM nodes including namespace resolution and child or attribute iteration.
